verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs describe on-demand GPU instance provisioning via console or REST API, with SSH and JupyterLab access preinstalled and Lambda Stack ready to use, and marketing pages claim deployment 'in minutes' with self-serve access (docs-5, docs-7, docs-16, docs-23, docs-28). Independent evidence (an unofficial CLI/MCP tool built atop the Lambda API for launching and SSHing into instances) corroborates that the provisioning-to-access flow works in practice. Missing for 10: a first-hand/independent timing benchmark confirming the 'minutes' claim, and no mention of auto-shutdown safeguards which the community flags as a lifecycle gap (though not disputing the provisioning speed itself).
